text:
You've been lying to yourself for years.

Write the truth tonight. What happened. What you felt. The thing you wouldn't admit.

One line. Raw.

30 days. You see the pattern.

The lie you're telling isn't about the future. It's about who you are now.

The page breaks it.

Start tonight.
caption:
Men call themselves broken without ever looking at themselves once. Writing changes that.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
